games.name: Air Hockey
games.rule: Score in the opposing goal! Use your finger to move your paddle and get 3 goals!

games.name: Animal Stack
games.rule: Take turns dropping animals. First player to drop an animal off the platform loses, so take care to drag left & right, and tap to rotate before you drop.

games.name: Archery
games.rule: Tap the screen, drag to aim, and release the arrow. Watch out for the wind! Hit the inner rings for higher scores. The player with the most points after three rounds wins.

games.name: Archery Master
games.rule: Load your bow and hit 70 targets before your opponent!

games.name: Backgammon
games.rule: Move your fifteen checkers according to the roll of two dice. The objective is to move all checkers into your home board and then bear them off. You can also hit opponent's blots to send them to the bar, delaying their progress.

games.name: Ball Games
games.rule: Shoot and score with every part of your body

games.name: Basketball
games.rule: Hoop! Take the ball when it's in your half of the field and shoot. Until the ball bounces off the ground, the opponent can't touch it!

games.name: Beach Ball
games.rule: Try to shoot the beachball over the opponent's side. First to 3 wins.

games.name: Blocks
games.rule: Place blocks in the 9x9 board and fill rows, columns or squares to clear them from the game.

games.name: Bowling
games.rule: Classic 10 pin bowling. Swipe to shoot your ball and knock down the pins. Highest score after 4 rounds wins!

games.name: Brick Blast
games.rule: Move the paddle with your finger to keep the balls in play. If you miss, your opponent scores a point.

games.name: Broken Tiles
games.rule: Run around but watch out, the ice breaks every time you run over it or stop on it.

games.name: Cannon Duel
games.rule: Use timing to aim and shoot your opponent's cannon. Watch out for the wind! First to get 3 hits wins

games.name: Carrom
games.rule: Pot all your pucks before your opponent and win. The Queen can be potted anytime but it must be potted before the last puck and must be covered immediately in the same turn.

games.name: Checkers
games.rule: Capture all your opponent's pieces!

games.name: Chess
games.rule: Chess! Capture your opponent's king and keep yours alive!

games.name: Chicken Jump
games.rule: Jump to stack blocks and get points if the block stops in the middle before the chicken lands on it.

games.name: Colour Wars
games.rule: Try to fill the entire field with your color. Click on your circles to enlarge the dots by one. Take 4 new squares when you reach 4 white dots in a circle.

games.name: Cornhole
games.rule: Throw your bags into the hole and try to push the other players' bags off the board.

games.name: Crabby Volley
games.rule: Drop the ball into your opponent's field! Five points to win!

games.name: Crash It
games.rule: Drive, jump and flip your car by tapping the buttons. Hit your opponent on the head with your car to score points and watch your own head so that nothing touches it!

games.name: Cup Pong
games.rule:
Swipe up to throw balls into cups!
Land in the cup to remove it. First to clear all your cups wins!

games.name: Darts
games.rule: Take turns throwing darts and be the first to score 301 points. The last dart must hit the exact score.

games.name: Dice Yatzy
games.rule: Take turns rolling the dice and try to score as many points as possible based on the combinations on the sheet.

games.name: Disco Battle
games.rule: Go wild at the disco! Press at the right moment when the notes hit your platform! Each mistake will lower your score, the one with more points at the end of the song wins!

games.name: Dots and Boxes
games.rule: Take turns tapping horizontal or vertical lines to connect the boxes. The last line that completes a box turns it into the line color. Own the most boxes to win.

games.name: Drop Four
games.rule: Connect 4 of the same colored discs in a row to win.

games.name: Dung Battle
games.rule: Move your beetle and bring the precious brown ball to your base! Don't get too close to ladybugs!

games.name: Explosive Festival
games.rule: Hit your opponent's side of the screen! Press to fire your rocket!

games.name: Fatal Siege
games.rule: Don't let the enemy soldiers get close, smash them first! Press at the right moment and hold to shoot farther!

games.name: Flappy Jump
games.rule: Tap to jump and shoot as many baskets as you can. First to 10 wins.

games.name: Frogs Fight
games.rule: Jump among the water lilies and catch the bugs! The dragonfly is worth 5 points and the first to reach 10 wins!

games.name: Frozen Beaks
games.rule: Collect 30 fish! Move your finger to walk and release it to slide on the ice! Don't fall in the hole!

games.name: Fruit Duel
games.rule: Watch the icon in the center and tap the saber as soon as you see a fruit (watermelon, pomgrenade, orange). First to 10 wins.

games.name: Golf Football
games.rule: Score points by shooting the ball into the hole. Find the right angle and the right power. The longer you press, the stronger the shot.

games.name: Gravity Run
games.rule: Tap to change gravity. Run fast and don't fall!

games.name: Guard and Thief
games.rule: The thief has to collect the coins, the guard must catch the thief. Whoever has more coins at the end of the match wins!

games.name: Guess Who
games.rule: Ask yes/no questions to narrow down which character the other player chose and guess it before they do.

games.name: Hammer Hit
games.rule: Hit the hammer when the needle is pointing up. The closer to the white line, the stronger the hit. The best score in 3 rounds wins!

games.name: Hand Slap
games.rule: Slap to score. Dodge to avoid. Dodging without a slap gives the attacker a point. First to 5 points wins!

games.name: Happy Birds
games.rule: Tap to fly. Avoid the spikes! Survive 3 times to win.

games.name: Happy Hippos
games.rule: Tap to eat balls and score. +2 points for your color, and -1 if you eat your opponent's color. First to 50 points wins!

games.name: Hot Potato
games.rule: Tap at the right moment to make the potato fly into your opponent's arms.

games.name: King of the Yard
games.rule: Take the crown and keep it on your head until the time is expired! Don't let your opponent touch you!

games.name: Knife Thrower
games.rule: Tap to throw knives. Land in the wood, avoiding other knives. First to 20 wins.

games.name: Light Fingers
games.rule: Steal the diamond faster than your opponent! First to 5 wins!

games.name: Ludo Dash
games.rule: Race one token from start to finish according to the rolls of a die. The first player to move one tokens to the end wins the game. Roll a six to move a token out of the starting area. Capture opponents' tokens by landing on the same space.

games.name: Lumberjack
games.rule: Tap on the left or right side to cut down the tree. But be careful not to get hit by the branches!

games.name: Mancala Pits
games.rule: Move your stones counterclockwise across the board and try to collect more stones than your opponent!

games.name: Match Rush
games.rule: Compare the 2 sets of objects. Find the 1 matching object before your opponent to earn a point. First to 10 points wins!

games.name: Math Duel
games.rule: The first player to solve the task gets a point. For any wrong answer the opponent gets a point. First to 10 wins.

games.name: Maze Paint
games.rule: Swipe to paint all squares to complete each level!

games.name: Memory Match
games.rule: Flip 2 cards and find pairs.

games.name: Mini Golf
games.rule: Hole in one! The player with 2 points more than the other wins!

games.name: Mini Soccer
games.rule: Move your finger to control your team! Who has scored more after 90 seconds wins!

games.name: Money Grabber
games.rule: Drag the money to your safe box using all the fingers of your hand!

games.name: Nuts and Bolts
games.rule:
Move nuts between the bolts until all the nuts on each bolt are the same colour!

You can only move nuts onto other nuts of the same colour.

games.name: Paint Fight
games.rule: Paint the screen with your color! The winner is the one who painted the most after 45 seconds!

games.name: Penalty Kicks
games.rule: Swipe your finger to dive or to kick the ball! First to 5 win!

games.name: Pinball Duel
games.rule: Tap left and right to fire the ball right in your opponent goal!

games.name: Ping Pong
games.rule: Use your finger to move the racket and to spin the ball. Get 7 points to win!

games.name: Piranha Rush
games.rule: Run from the piranhas! And watch out for corals!

games.name: Pizza Memory
games.rule: Watch the order and recompose the pizza exactly as you saw it. When you're done, remember to ring the bell!

games.name: Pool
games.rule: A classic! Throw the balls of your color into the holes and finally the black ball!

games.name: Pop It
games.rule: Players take turns pressing down any number of bubbles in a single row and consecutively. The player who presses down the last bubble loses the game.

games.name: Pull the Rope
games.rule: Tap as fast as you can to pull hard! Pull the flag across the line to win!

games.name: Racing Cars
games.rule: Compete against your opponent and finish first! Move your finger to drive the car.

games.name: Rat Race
games.rule: Press to run! Run away from the cats' paws and collect the pieces of cheese before your opponent!

games.name: Reversi
games.rule: Fill the board with more pieces of your color than the opponents to win!

games.name: Road Dodge
games.rule: Tap to steer left and right to dodge obstacles on the road

games.name: Robot Arena
games.rule: Survive the obstacles in the deadly robot arena! Dodge lasers, spinning blades and cannonballs!

games.name: Rock Paper Scissors
games.rule: Press the button of your choice before the hand stops. First to 3 wins.

games.name: Sea Battle
games.rule: Place your ships without showing your opponent and take turns guessing your opponent's ship locations

games.name: Ship Battle
games.rule: Protect your ship from your opponent's cannon shots! Move your finger to move the shield!

games.name: Shuriken
games.rule: Cut the bamboo canes of your opponent! Grab the shuriken and throw it! Move your finger to add spin to your shot.

games.name: Shut the Box
games.rule: Roll the dice, then flip one or more numbered tiles that add up to your roll. Keep playing until no move is possible.

games.name: Sliding Puzzle
games.rule: This is a classic Sliding Puzzle game. Move the boxes into the correct order.

games.name: Sling Puck
games.rule: Shoot all pucks into the opponent's side of the board to win

games.name: Slot Cars
games.rule: Tap the screen and race your car round the laps as fast as you can. But be careful, if flames come out of the car, you should slow down in the curves by taking your finger off the screen!

games.name: Snake Clash
games.rule: Don't touch the other player's snake body! Move your finger to change direction and stay alive!

games.name: Snakes and Ladders
games.rule: Roll a die to move across the board. Land on a ladder to climb higher, or a snake to slide down. First to reach or pass the last field wins!

games.name: Snowball Throw
games.rule: Snowball fight! Pull back to aim. Release to throw. Hit your opponent. First to reduce their opponent's health to zero wins!

games.name: Soccer Pool
games.rule: Take turns to hit the ball and score.

games.name: Solitaire
games.rule: This is a classic Solitaire game. Depending on the selected difficulty, different numbers of cards are revealed.

games.name: Spike Attacks
games.rule: Hide behind the stones so you don't get hit by the spikes.

games.name: Spin War
games.rule: Push your opponent out of the bowl! Use your finger to move the spinner! 4 points to win!

games.name: Stampede
games.rule: Look for dangers coming from the left or right and jump to avoid them

games.name: Star Catcher
games.rule: Catch all the stars and be aware of black holes! First to get 7 stars wins!

games.name: Sticky Tongues
games.rule: Use your tongue to catch the dragonfly, and use the joystick to escape from your opponent's blows! Don't miss too many shots or you'll lose the match!

games.name: Sudoku
games.rule: Play Sudoku, train your brain and beat your highscore

games.name: Sumo Push
games.rule: Tap as fast as you can to push out your opponent! Stay in the ring!

games.name: Sword Throwing
games.rule: Draw your sword and throw it towards the targets of your enemy. Hold it in your hand and move it to parry your opponents throws!

games.name: Tanks
games.rule: Destroy the enemy tank. Use the left stick to move and the right to shoot!

games.name: Tap Match
games.rule: Tap to collect cards. Complete sets of 3 to clear cards. You can hold up to 7 cards in your stack, so collect strategically.

games.name: Target Practice
games.rule: Shoot targets to score points. Small targets score double. First to 10 points wins. Tap to start, then tap to aim up, then tap to fire.

games.name: Taxi Race
games.rule: Drive your taxi past the other cars or jump over them. Swipe your finger to the left, right or up.

games.name: Tennis
games.rule: Click to jump with the player and hit the ball. If you hit it with the center of the tennis racket, the ball will go really fast.

games.name: The Last Sashimi
games.rule: Eat all before your opponent! First to 15 wins, sashimi is worth 1 point, onigiri is worth 3 point and for every mistake you lose a point!

games.name: Tic Tac Toe
games.rule: Red is cross, blue is circle!

games.name: Traffic Jam
games.rule: Crash your opponent and be careful not to fall into the water! Use the joystick to steer.

games.name: Ultimate Tic Tac Toe
games.rule: Play on a big board with nine small tic-tac-toe games. Where you place your mark tells the other player where they must play next. Win small boards, then get three small boards in a row to win.

games.name: Unfair Fishing
games.rule: Throw the bait and rewind the reel! First to catch 25 fishes wins!

games.name: Water Game
games.rule: The balls swim in water. Give the balls speed by pressing the buttons. Let the ball fly through the basket. First to 15 wins.

games.name: Whack a Mole
games.rule: Hit the moles, but only those of your color! The first one that gets to 30 wins!

games.name: Wheelie
games.rule: Accelerate your bike to pull up a wheelie. Earn more points the longer you maintain a wheelie.

games.name: Wobble Stack
games.rule: Take turns dropping brainrots. First player to drop a brainrots off the platform loses, so take care to drag left & right, and tap to rotate before you drop.

games.name: Wrestle
games.rule: Jump and try not to fall on your head. Try to push your opponent to the ground instead. Watch the wind!
